workstreams._default_rule: Published does not mean frozen. Every funnel stage remains independently editable and versioned. Only an explicit user command freezes a stage.

definition_of_done: all newly created candidate workbooks use the current structure
questionnaire 1 and questionnaire 2 fields are imported
appointment and funnel timeline are event-synchronized
manual interviewer values and checkboxes are preserved
the user explicitly says the stage is approved and fixed
productivity_interview_sheet.rule: The current template remains editable, but rollout is new-only. Existing candidate folders and interview workbooks are historical artifacts and must never be reopened, migrated or autofilled by replayed sync events. A new workbook is created only when Test 1 is completed and candidate_drive has no folder for that candidate.

definition_of_done: operator Не прошёл removes the candidate from the active candidate group immediately
candidate Не актуально removes the candidate from the active candidate group immediately
candidate Спасибо leaves the candidate in the active group
Telegram confirmation and any error are stored in the candidate card
no live candidate is changed during code verification
productivity_outcome_group_removal.rule: Removal is event-driven and idempotent. It applies only to the active candidate group after the specified outcome; it does not delete candidate records, messages, tests, Google Drive files or history.
